subject: Verify your account now or it will be suspended
body: Dear Customer, we detected unusual activity on your account. Click here to verify your identity immediately: http://bit.ly/2KdjX9. Failure to act within 24 hours will result in account suspension. Enter your password and SSN to confirm.
label: phishing

subject: You've won a $1000 Walmart gift card!
body: Congratulations! You have been selected to claim your $1000 reward. Click now to claim your prize before it expires: http://walmart-rewards.club/claim
label: phishing

subject: Weekly team standup notes
body: Hi all, here are the notes from this week's standup. We're on track for the release next Friday. Let me know if you have questions.
label: legitimate

subject: Your Microsoft 365 subscription is expiring
body: Dear user, your Office 365 subscription has expired. Update your payment information now to avoid service interruption: http://microsoft-renew.top/billing/update
label: phishing

subject: Invoice #4521 from Acme Corp
body: Hi, please find attached invoice #4521 for last month's services. Let us know if you have any questions about the charges.
label: legitimate

subject: Confirm your Apple ID for security purposes
body: Dear Customer, your Apple ID has been locked due to suspicious activity. Verify your identity now: http://apple-secure-id.info/verify to restore access immediately.
label: phishing

subject: Reminder: Dentist appointment tomorrow
body: This is a reminder that you have an appointment scheduled for tomorrow at 2:00 PM. Please arrive 10 minutes early.

subject: URGENT: Wire transfer required today
body: Hi, I need you to process an urgent wire transfer today before the bank closes. This is time sensitive, please confirm you can do this now and I will send the account details.

subject: Your package delivery failed
